newsitem.title: USA: Lucent alleges Newbridge patent infringement.
newsitem.headline: Lucent alleges Newbridge patent infringement.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc said it filed a patent infringement lawsuit Tuesday against Newbridge Networks Corp and its subsidiary, Newbridge Networks Inc of Herndon, Va.
Filed in U.S. District Court in Delaware, the lawsuit charges Newbridge with infringing four specific patents associated with data networking, Lucent said.

The patents cover Bell Labs-developed technology that increases the efficiency of communications networks by controlling data traffic congestion, by detecting and correcting transmission errors and by compressing digitized voiceband signals.
Lucent said the suit affects Newbridge's networking products, including the company's 36170 ATM switch and its MainStreet 3600 product line.
"We have critical technologies in the data networking area and we intend to protect them," said Richard J. Rawson, senior vice president and general counsel of Lucent Technologies.
